To find the stationary points of a function y = f(x), first, find the first derivative of the function, f'(x). Then, set the first derivative equal to zero and solve for x. These x-values correspond to the stationary points. To determine whether these points are maxima, minima, or points of inflection, find the second derivative, f''(x), and evaluate it at the stationary points.
